EaseMate is an all-in-one AI assistant platform empowering users worldwide with generative AI for study, research, and creativity. The platform provides AI chat, image generation, and video creation tools that help students, researchers, and creators streamline workflows and unlock creative potential. Alibaba Cloud's AIGC services — including high-performance image and video generation — allowed EaseMate to deliver premium tools without the need for dedicated accelerated compute resources. Importantly, Alibaba Cloud's integrated generative AI security provided the company with enterprise-grade content moderation out of the box.
